description: This file contains utility functions for generating curl and fetch commands from network request data, including platform-specific escaping functions and handling of request headers and post data.

methods.name: generateCurlCommand
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a cURL command string from a trace model and network resource entry.

methods.name: generateFetchCall
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a fetch API call string from a trace model and network resource entry.

methods.name: fetchRequestPostData
methods.description: Fetches the post data for a network resource, either from a SHA1 hash or directly from the request data.
